Introduction **nf-core/scalpel** quantifies transcript isoforms and alternative polyadenylation (APA) at the single-cell level from 3'-tagged scRNA-seq data (10x Genomics Chromium 3', Drop-seq), as described in [Ake et al., _Nat Commun_ 2025](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61118-0). 1. **Annotation processing** — salmon pseudobulk quantification and selection of the isoforms distinguishable by 3'-tagged reads (isoforms with close 3' ends and identical exons near the 3' end are collapsed). 2. **Reads processing** — reads of the filtered cells mapped to the selected isoforms, internal priming artifacts removed. 3. **Isoform quantification** — EM estimation of the isoform abundances per cell and gene, isoform-by-cell count matrices (iDGE). 4. **APA characterization** — differential isoform usage between samples or cell clusters.
## Usage > [!NOTE] > If you are new to Nextflow and nf-core, please refer to [this page](https://nf-co.re/docs/usage/installation) on how to set-up Nextflow (>= 26.04). Test your setup with `-profile test` before running the workflow on actual data. ### Quick test ```bash nextflow run plasslab/nf-core-scalpel -profile test,docker --outdir results_test ``` Use `conda`, `singularity` or `apptainer` instead of `docker`, `test_dropseq` for the Drop-seq test data, and add `emulate_amd64` on Apple Silicon with Docker. ### Samplesheet ```csv title="samplesheet.csv" sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,cranger_path SRR6129050,fastq/SRR6129050_R1.fastq.gz,fastq/SRR6129050_R2.fastq.gz,cellranger/SRR6129050 SRR6129051,fastq/SRR6129051_R1.fastq.gz,fastq/SRR6129051_R2.fastq.gz,cellranger/SRR6129051 ``` | Column | Description | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `sample` | Sample name (no spaces). Several rows with the same name = several runs of one sample. | | `fastq_1/2` | R1 / R2 FASTQ files (optional with `--isoform_annotation`). | | `cranger_path` | Cell Ranger, Cell Ranger ARC or STARsolo sample directory (Drop-seq: BAM file). | | `dge` | Drop-seq only: Drop-seq tools DGE count matrix. | ### Running the pipeline ```bash nextflow run plasslab/nf-core-scalpel \ -profile \ --samplesheet samplesheet.csv \ --transcriptome gencode.vM21.transcripts.fa.gz \ --gtf gencode.vM21.annotation.gtf.gz \ --genome GRCm38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz \ --outdir results ``` The internal priming reference is built from `--genome`; a pre-built one can be given with `--ip_reference` ([mm10](https://zenodo.org/records/15664563/files/mm10_polya.track.tar.gz?download=1), [GRCh38](https://zenodo.org/records/15717592/files/hg38_ipriming_sites.bed.tar.gz?download=1), or `/ip_reference/` of a previous run). BAM files, GTF and genome must use the same chromosome names (checked by the pipeline). | Option | Use | | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `--clusters` | Compare cell clusters instead of samples (`sample`, `barcode`, `cluster`). | | `--barcodes_whitelist` | Restrict the analysis to selected cells (CSV `sample,barcodes`). | | `--isoform_annotation` | Reuse the isoforms of a previous run (`/isoform`) to add samples; BAM input only. | | `--sequencing_platform` | `chromium` (default) or `dropseq`. | ### Parameters | Parameter | Default | Description | | -------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `--distance_3end` | `100` | Maximum distance (nt) between the 3' ends of collapsed isoforms. | | `--distance_profile` | `500` | Window (nt from the 3' end) where collapsed isoforms have identical exons. | | `--distance_reads` | `600` | Maximum distance (nt) of a read from the isoform 3' end. | | `--min_mapq` | `255` | Minimum mapping quality (255: uniquely mapped reads). | | `--distance_ip` | `200` | Internal priming sites closer to the 3' end are ignored. | | `--gene_fraction` | `98%` | Genes used to learn the read distance distribution. | | `--binsize` | `20` | Bin size (nt) of the read distance distribution. | | `--em_tol` | `1e-6` | EM convergence tolerance. | | `--em_max_iter` | `1000` | Maximum number of EM iterations. | See the [usage documentation](docs/usage.md) for details. > [!WARNING] > Please provide pipeline parameters via the CLI or Nextflow `-params-file` option. Custom config files including those provided by the `-c` Nextflow option can be used to provide any configuration _**except for parameters**_; see [docs](https://nf-co.re/docs/usage/getting_started/configuration#custom-configuration-files). ## Pipeline output | Directory | Content | | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `dge/` | Isoform count matrices per sample (sparse 10x format, features `gene***isoform`). | | `differential/` | Differential isoform usage (`DIU_table.csv`) and Seurat object (`iDGE_seurat.RDS`). | | `filtered_bams/` | Reads used for the quantification. | | `isoform/` | Selected isoforms (reusable with `--isoform_annotation`). | | `ip_reference/` | Internal priming reference built from the genome. | | `probability/` | Read distance distribution to the 3' end per sample. | | `pipeline_info/` | Execution reports and software versions. | Intermediate files (`salmon/`, `transcript/`, `bed/`, `reads/`, `ip/`, `fragment/`, `cell/`, `em/`) are described in the [output documentation](docs/output.md). ### Downstream analysis - [10X Chromium example](https://raw.githack.com/plasslab/SCALPEL/refs/heads/dev/docs/chromium.html) · [downstream analysis](https://raw.githack.com/plasslab/SCALPEL/refs/heads/dev/docs/chromium_downstream.html) - [Drop-seq example](https://raw.githack.com/plasslab/SCALPEL/refs/heads/dev/docs/dropseq.html) · [downstream analysis](https://raw.githack.com/plasslab/SCALPEL/refs/heads/dev/docs/dropseq_downstream.html) ### Testing `quarto render test.qmd` runs the test suite (end-to-end runs, regression and unit tests) and writes a report. ## Credits nf-core/scalpel was originally written by Franz AKE. We thank the following people for their extensive assistance in the development of this pipeline: - Marcel Schilling - Sandra M. Fernández-Moya - Akshay Jaya Ganesh - Ana Gutiérrez-Franco - Lei Li - Mireya Plass ## Contributions and Support If you would like to contribute to this pipeline, please see the [contributing guidelines](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). For further information or help, don't hesitate to get in touch on the [Slack `#scalpel` channel](https://nfcore.slack.com/channels/scalpel) (you can join with [this invite](https://nf-co.re/join/slack)). ## Citations If you use nf-core/scalpel for your analysis, please cite: > Franz Ake, Marcel Schilling, Sandra M. Fernández-Moya, Akshay Jaya Ganesh, Ana Gutiérrez-Franco, Lei Li, Mireya Plass. > **Quantification of transcript isoforms at the single-cell level using SCALPEL.** > _Nat Commun_ 16, 6402 (2025). doi: [10.1038/s41467-025-61118-0](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61118-0) An extensive list of references for the tools used by the pipeline can be found in the [`CITATIONS.md`](CITATIONS.md) file.
